name: lastnormal_item_sieve_040

source_description_evidence: This is no mere strainer for noodles; it's a laboratory-grade sieve used to separate particles of certain sizes.  You could use this to do a really good job sifting flour, remove dust and soil from grain, or perhaps conduct gradation tests for any civil engineers you might know.  This one has been constructed from steel mesh.
Some fine steel mesh attached to a length of thicker steel wire, forming a rigid frame.  Useful for sieving.
